# NEW 2026-11-22 v11.0 Worker 1 Slot 84: Dynamic Epidemics, Venetian Double-Island Lazarettos, Habsburg Pestkordon & Wu Youxing Wenyi Lun (oe_dis_, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_dynamic_diseases.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Decision 1: Enact 40-Day Port Quarantena (Population vs Customs trade-off; halved penalty with Lazzaretto Nuovo or Granaries)
oe_dis_dec_quarantena_40_days = {
	decision_category = government_decisions
	hide_repeatable_tag = yes
	potential = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		NOT = { oe_dis_rule_is_off = yes }
		OR = {
			oe_dis_neighbor_or_self_infected = yes
			oe_dis_has_any_lazaretto = yes
		}
	}
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_dis_player_only_tt
			is_ai = no
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_dis_quarantena_cd_tt
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_dis_quarantena_cd }
		}
		gold >= 40
	}
	ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
	illustration_tags = { 10 = exterior }
	illustration_scope = {
		event_illustration_poptype_effect = {
			foreground = pop_type:burghers
			background = pop_type:clergy
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = oe_dis_dec_quarantena_40_days.a
		effect = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_dis_quarantena_cd years = 3 }
			if = {
				limit = { oe_dis_has_granary_relief = yes }
				add_gold = -25
			}
			else = {
				add_gold = -50
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						has_variable = oe_dis_nuovo_built
						any_owned_location = {
							has_building = building_type:oe_dis_lazzaretto_nuovo
						}
					}
				}
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_dis_quarantena_nuovo_mod years = 3 mode = replace }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { oe_dis_has_granary_relief = yes }
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_dis_quarantena_granary_mod years = 3 mode = replace }
			}
			else = {
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_dis_quarantena_strict_mod years = 3 mode = replace }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Decision 2: Establish Permanent Magistrato alla Sanita (Port Health Magistracy)
oe_dis_dec_sanita_magistracy = {
	decision_category = government_decisions
	only_once = yes
	only_once_scope = country
	potential = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		NOT = { has_variable = oe_dis_sanita_established }
		has_ports = yes
	}
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_dis_player_only_tt
			is_ai = no
		}
		any_owned_location = {
			count >= 2
			is_coastal = yes
			OR = {
				location_rank ?= location_rank:city
				location_rank ?= location_rank:megalopolis
			}
		}
		oe_dis_has_any_lazaretto = yes
		gold >= 120
		stability >= 5
	}
	ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
	illustration_tags = { 10 = interior }
	illustration_scope = {
		event_illustration_poptype_effect = {
			foreground = pop_type:burghers
			background = pop_type:nobles
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = oe_dis_dec_sanita_magistracy.a
		effect = {
			add_gold = -120
			set_variable = { name = oe_dis_sanita_established value = 1 }
			add_prestige = prestige_mild_bonus
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_dis_sanita_magistracy_mod years = -1 mode = replace }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_dis_ev3_done } }
				set_variable = { name = oe_dis_ev3_done value = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_dis.3
			}
		}
	}
}

# Decision 3: Promulgate Wu Youxing's Treatise on Pestilence (Wenyi Lun, 1642)
oe_dis_dec_wenyi_treatise = {
	decision_category = government_decisions
	only_once = yes
	only_once_scope = country
	potential = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		NOT = { has_variable = oe_dis_wenyi_adopted }
		OR = {
			current_year >= 1620
			has_variable = oe_dis_wenyi_unlocked
		}
	}
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_dis_player_only_tt
			is_ai = no
		}
		oe_dis_is_wenyi_eligible_realm = yes
		gold >= 90
	}
	ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
	illustration_tags = { 10 = interior }
	illustration_scope = {
		event_illustration_poptype_effect = {
			foreground = pop_type:clergy
			background = pop_type:burghers
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = oe_dis_dec_wenyi_treatise.a
		effect = {
			add_gold = -90
			set_variable = { name = oe_dis_wenyi_adopted value = 1 }
			add_prestige = prestige_weak_bonus
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_dis_wenyi_treatise_mod years = -1 mode = replace }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_dis_ev8_done } }
				set_variable = { name = oe_dis_ev8_done value = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_dis.8
			}
		}
	}
}

# Decision 4: Charter the Frontier Pestkordon Sanitary Cordon (1680+)
oe_dis_dec_pestkordon_border = {
	decision_category = government_decisions
	only_once = yes
	only_once_scope = country
	potential = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		NOT = { has_variable = oe_dis_pestkordon_enacted }
		OR = {
			current_year >= 1680
			has_variable = oe_dis_pestkordon_built
		}
	}
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_dis_player_only_tt
			is_ai = no
		}
		num_locations >= 20
		OR = {
			oe_dis_neighbor_or_self_infected = yes
			oe_dis_has_pestkordon = yes
		}
		gold >= 200
	}
	ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
	illustration_tags = { 10 = exterior }
	illustration_scope = {
		event_illustration_poptype_effect = {
			foreground = pop_type:soldiers
			background = pop_type:nobles
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = oe_dis_dec_pestkordon_border.a
		effect = {
			add_gold = -200
			set_variable = { name = oe_dis_pestkordon_enacted value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_dis_quarantine_triumph value = 1 }
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_dis_pestkordon_cordon_mod years = -1 mode = replace }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_dis_ev7_done } }
				set_variable = { name = oe_dis_ev7_done value = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_dis.7
			}
		}
	}
}
